proposals.evidence: DEDR 4753 gives Tamil maẓai, Malayalam maẓa, Kannada maẓe, Kodagu/Tulu maḷe, Kota may and Toda maw ‘rain’. These simple stems are linked with the rain sense; rain-cloud or rainfall verbal compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1025 gives Tamil oṉpatu/ompatu, Malayalam ompatu, Kannada ombattu/ombhattu, Kodagu oymbadi, Kota orbād, Tulu ormba and Gondi unmā nine.
